4a1('bum): //byed do//nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi yid la bya ba dang myi ldan bas/tshor ba gang dben ba'i rnam par yid la byed pa de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis yid la byed do//nyan thos 
4a2('bum): dang rang sangs rgyas kyi yidal bya ba dang myi ldan pas/'du shes gang myi rtag pa'i rnam par yid la byed de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyi yid la byed do//nyan thas dang rang sangs rgyas kyis yid la bya ba dang myi
4a3('bum): ldan pas/'du shes gang sdug bsngal ba'i rnam par yid la bye ba de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul kyis yid la byed do//nyan tathos dang rang sangs rgyas gyi yid la bya ba dang mi ldan pas/'du shes gang bdag myed
4a4('bum): pa'i rnam par yid la byed do de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyid yid la byed do//nyan pa dang rang sangs rgyas kyi yod la bya ba dang myi ldan pas ba dang myi ldan pas 'du shes gang zhi ba'i rnam par yid
4a5('bum): la byed pa de myi dmyigs ba'i tshul gyis yid la byed de/nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi yin la bya ba dang myi ldan bas/'du shes gang stong ba'i rnam par yid la byad pa de myi dmyigs pa'i
4a6('bum): tshul gyis yid la byed do//nyan thos dang rang sangs rgus kyi yid la bya ba dang myi ldan ba 'du shes gang mtshan ma myed pa'i rnam par yid la byed pa de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gsum gyis yid la byed do//

4b8('bum): par yid la byed pa de spyi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis yid la bye do //nyan thos dang rang sangs rgas kyi yid la bya ba dang mi ldan bas /'du byed gag dben pa'i rnam par yid la bye ba de myi dmyigs pa'i
